what: Physical right Maker Arm picked up the upright yellow cylinder: grasped, lifted ~6 cm, placed back and returned to verified rest in a 16 s replayed run. Left arm attempt missed high.
why: First physical pickup. Wrist-camera servoing plus measured waypoints replaced the stalled full camera-to-arm calibration.
details: Guarded seven-joint controller (gravity-residual torque, speed, temperature guards; holds on trip, SDK verified return before release) with SDK gripper capped closing and 0.5 Nm hold. Motor heating under extended load is the limiting factor: slow step-by-step approaches tripped the 48/52 C guards, while fast waypoint replay stays under 46 C. The left arm has a different claw and offsets (same model height is roughly 10 cm higher physically) and needs its own height reference. Dream-1 key is in team 1Password (DREAM_API_KEY) and not yet available on this Mac.
